items.Sentence: LAVWMA wastewater also contains reverse osmosis reject water from the Zone 7 Water Agency that is mixed with the Dublin San Ramon Services District’s final effluent. This reject water results from the Zone 7 Water Agency’s Demineralization and Brine Disposal Project, which removes salts from groundwater in the Zone 7 Water Agency’s jurisdiction.
The Marina Dechlorination Facility dechlorinates treated and disinfected effluent from the EBDA and LAVWMA member agencies using sodium bisulfite.
